item.title: Jewish organization hosts hundreds for ‘Mega Shabbat’ dinner
item.description: Hundreds celebrated the start of the Jewish day of rest at Chabad at UA’s “Mega Shabbat” dinner Friday evening inside Bryant-Denny Stadium.
